messages:
tess: Following the postmortem: we need a concise follow-up tracker for vendor/dependency outages (cloud auth spike + model-registry flaps). Assigning owners here.

tess: Action items I sketched: 1) short-term registry auth fallback; 2) cloud provider retry/backoff + circuit breaker; 3) model-registry synthetic canary + error-rate dashboards; 4) monthly vendor SLA review + quarterly drill.

omar: I can own #1 (registry fallback). Plan: shim that prefers cached metadata + feature flag for canary. PR by end of week.

anya: taking #3 (canary + dashboards). Will add 5m canary job emitting latency/p99/5xx-rate and a Grafana panel. Prototype by Wednesday.

kevin: I'll take #2 (retry/backoff). Start with backoff tuning and add a transient-failure circuit that falls back after x failures. ETA: staging rollout next Tue.

tess: please include a token-stretch short-circuit so clients avoid refresh storms during registry auth failures (stretch TTL by ~2m).

omar: noted 34 will include config ENV var REGISTRY_FALLBACK_MODE=read-cache and a TTL-hint header to signal clients.

anya: telemetry will emit an explicit event when fallback triggers: event=registry_fallback reason=auth_5xx canary_id=..., so we can correlate traces.

kevin: I'll also update PD escalation to require 15m ack for vendor-auth regressions and schedule a recurring Ops calendar invite for monthly vendor SLA review.

sre-bot: reminder: create follow-up ticket "vendor-dep-mitigation-2026Q2" assigned to tess, omar, anya, kevin (due 2026-05-10).

tess: please add a one-line status to the postmortem doc by EOD Fri and link PRs/tickets. I'll compile and send to leadership.

omar: PR coming: https://git.internal/repo/registry-fallback/pull/99

anya: monitoring PR: https://git.internal/repo/monitoring/pull/312

kevin: created ticket: https://tickets.internal/INC-6120 34 includes PR links + rollout plan.

tess: thanks all. If timelines change ping me directly. Closing this thread once everyone updates the postmortem.
